implementation: Fixed read-only registry adds eight picture-profile values, four accessibility values, five General values and three OLED-care/energy values
Signed and unsigned ranges validate type, bounds and interval; enums validate current membership and reject hidden/inactive options, duplicate descriptors and unexpected dimensions
Picture extras require matching input/picture-mode dimensions and a full picture read before/after the expanded cycle; changed profiles withdraw the whole picture reading
Accessibility, General and Panel Care expire independently; a failed General namespace withdraws only its own rows when the other namespace remains readable
Native freshness timestamps conservatively start before the worker read cycle; service calls remain on a worker with bounded payload/array sizes
Known read-only values remain legible using the shared table ink; form bindings stay disabled, so presentation cannot grant setting-write authority
Normal interactive sessions do not persist the diagnostic expanded readout receipt or capture frames

pilot_audit.scope: Read-only LG descriptors/values; proprietary Settings source used privately to locate named keys, not copied into the public application

first_g2_proof.receipt_issue: A host test variable reused for an expanded settings reply made the first core comparison false. Saved core hash files matched and an independent fresh cleanup/state recheck passed. The private driver was corrected before the final proof.

limits: All added setting values remain read-only or LG-managed; no native setting setter or privileged broker was added
Descriptor ranges/options are readout validation, not control-write authority or proof of physical picture effect
Picture fields describe the settings-service profile; a default profile and no HDMI signal do not prove the currently displayed video source/HDR pipeline
Physical input, editable choice/range widgets, broader settings coverage, HDMI live playback/format, reboot and sustained performance remain incomplete
Earlier 0.14 timing measurements do not establish performance of this larger read registry
privacy: TV inventories, addresses, credentials, favourites, raw values/descriptors, proprietary LG source and native household captures remain private.
